description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing shopping list data in a Vue 3 application. It includes state, getters, and actions for handling shopping list entries, categories, supermarkets, synchronization, and undo functionality.

methods.name: updateEntriesStructure
methods.description: Updates the shopping list display structure, optionally for a specific meal plan.

methods.name: getEntriesStructure
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical data structure of shopping list entries grouped by category or other criteria.

methods.name: updateEntryInShoppingList
methods.description: Optimistically updates a shopping list entry in the local store.

methods.name: getFlatEntries
methods.description: Returns a flattened list of shopping entries for export.

methods.name: hasFailedItems
methods.description: Checks if there are any failed sync items in the queue.

methods.name: refreshFromAPI
methods.description: Fetches shopping list data, supermarkets, and categories from the API, optionally filtered by meal plan.

methods.name: recLoadShoppingListEntries
methods.description: Recursively loads paginated shopping list entries from the API.

methods.name: autoSync
methods.description: Performs an auto-sync to fetch recent changes since last sync.

methods.name: createObject
methods.description: Creates a new shopping list entry via API and updates the store.

methods.name: updateObject
methods.description: Updates an existing shopping list entry via API.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes a shopping list entry via API and updates the store.

methods.name: getAssociatedRecipes
methods.description: Returns recipes associated with unchecked shopping list entries.

methods.name: getEntryCategoryKey
methods.description: Determines the category key for a shopping list entry based on current grouping settings.

methods.name: updateEntryInStructure
methods.description: Adds an entry to the hierarchical shopping list structure.

methods.name: setEntriesCheckedState
methods.description: Checks or unchecks a set of shopping list entries, with optional undo registration.

methods.name: _replaySyncQueue
methods.description: Processes queued sync requests, retrying failed ones.

methods.name: runSyncQueue
methods.description: Schedules the sync queue to run after a specified timeout.

methods.name: setEntriesDelayedState
methods.description: Delays or undelays shopping list entries.

methods.name: setFoodIgnoredState
methods.description: Marks foods as ignored for shopping and checks associated entries.

methods.name: deleteEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple shopping list entries.

methods.name: deleteShoppingListRecipe
methods.description: Deletes a shopping list recipe and associated entries.

methods.name: registerChange
methods.description: Records a change for undo functionality.

methods.name: undoChange
methods.description: Reverts the last change from the undo stack.

methods.name: updateCategories
methods.description: Updates the category of multiple foods via API.

methods.name: updateEntryShoppingLists
methods.description: Updates shopping list associations for entries.

methods.name: loadShoppingLists
methods.description: Loads shopping lists from API.
